tokens_lead: Long-lived tokens for integrations (export, BI, CI)
tokens_show_warning: Copy the token now — we won't show it again
tokens_revoke_confirm_lead: All integrations using this token will stop working. This cannot be undone.
webhooks_lead: Outbound HTTP delivery of events with HMAC signatures
webhooks_format_raw: Raw — our JSON with HMAC signature
webhooks_format_raw_hint: Custom receiver: validate the X-EoP-Signature header yourself.
webhooks_format_slack_hint: Paste a Slack incoming-webhook URL — we format it for Block Kit.
webhooks_secret_lead: Use this to verify HMAC signatures on incoming requests. Copy it now — we won't show it again.
webhooks_delete_confirm_lead: Deliveries will stop immediately. This cannot be undone.
devices_lead: Browser extensions, desktop agents and IDE plugins paired to this account
devices_claim_lead: Enter the 6-letter code shown by the device
devices_claim_success: Device paired — it will start sending events within a few seconds.
devices_claim_error_invalid: Code invalid or expired. Restart pairing on the device.
devices_claim_error_used: Code already used. Restart pairing on the device.
devices_revoke_confirm_lead: The device will stop sending events. You can pair it again later.
